svg.title: About me — from pixel to database
svg.text: Trained in multimedia (BUT MMI), now doing a Software
Engineering Mastère at ISCOD. I started with the
front — Figma, React, accessibility — then moved down
to the back. I've shipped a product used by L'Oréal, a
client website on my own and a real-time app used live.
Looking for a full-stack alternance · 4 days company / 1 day class
